name: Siân Jones
title: Broadcast journalist, conference host and presentation coach
bio_short: Broadcast journalist, conference host and presentation coach. Former BBC, ITV News, Bloomberg, CNBC and SKY News. Clients include HSBC, Barclays, Deloitte, NATO, AstraZeneca and the European Parliament. Hosted more than 400 events. UK-based.
bio: Siân is a broadcast journalist, conference host and presentation coach specialising in public speaking, media skills and on-camera communication. She has more than 20 years' experience in live television, having presented news for BBC, ITV Morning News, Bloomberg Television, CNBC Europe, SKY News and Channel 5. She began her career as an actress in Hong Kong, where she became a TV presenter for six years before returning to the UK and mainstream broadcasting.  As a conference host and facilitator, Siân has hosted more than 400 events for clients including HSBC, Barclays, Deloitte, Novartis, Pfizer, AstraZeneca, NATO, Vodafone, Coca-Cola, Fujitsu and the European Parliament. She is the founder of Web Presenter Training, through which she coaches business leaders on presentation skills, media relations, storytelling and leadership presence.  At ISOC, Siân delivers public speaking, presentation skills, media training and webcast training programmes. Her broadcast and hosting experience gives her a practical understanding of how to command an audience, manage timing and deliver content with clarity and authority. She is particularly effective at helping professionals prepare for conferences, investor presentations, media appearances and virtual events. Her webcast training capability is increasingly relevant as organisations adopt hybrid communication formats. Siân is based in the UK and trains in English.
